reviews.text: Excellent service, friendly staff, and you can see their love for their furry patients.
I took my dog ​​there because of an allergy, but it was better to take him to my trusted vet who actually gave him medication and pills. They're only interested in taking people's money.
They helped us get my pet microchipped. It was very quick and my dog ​​didn't feel any pain; she usually cries during vaccinations.
The best service for your furry initiative!!!

The emergency service is terrible, with inexperienced "doctors" who can't diagnose. I took a kitten there who had just been attacked by two Pitbulls. They told me that the ultrasound they did showed no hernia, no damaged organs, and to wait until the next day to see if she improved, saying she was barely in pain because of the position of her ears and eyes. The next day, I took her to a veterinarian I trust who has almost 40 years of experience. After examining her, checking her over, and touching her with his hands, he told me it was her diaphragm. They took an x-ray, and it turned out she had a diaphragmatic hernia.
And the $1000 I paid for the examination and consultation at this second-rate veterinary clinic in Plan de San Luis was completely useless. The injection they gave her didn't help at all, and the kitten just kept suffering and getting more and more constricted from all the movement. Doctors Roque and Juan Carlos, who only want to get rich at the expense of animals, leave inexperienced doctors in charge of their emergency service, just taking people's money. Upstairs, where they keep the animals they board, it's a filthy mess. The operating room is also upstairs, and it's a tiny, incredibly uncomfortable, and filthy place. Across the street is the feline veterinary clinic, but they perform their surgeries there with Juan Carlos and Roque in that cramped little space. The service is terrible, the care is awful, and the diagnoses are terrible.

I was extremely disappointed with the service I received from a veterinarian last night. I took my one-and-a-half-year-old dog in because he had a laceration on his testicles. She examined him and from the very first moment seemed completely uninterested in the problem. She didn't even spend five minutes telling me he needed to be neutered (the wound was just on the surface of the skin, not inside his testicles). She never gave me a diagnosis, and without asking, she made an appointment for the next day to neuter my dog, telling me he had to stay! It really upset me. I wasn't satisfied with that experience; I left and found another veterinarian where the treatment was completely different from the moment I arrived! Terrible service.
this vet genuinely sentenced my cat to death. no kidney problems according to them. WRONG! worsening stage 4 kidney disease that led to him having to be put that easily couldve been avoided

Looking for recommendations, we found this vet to spay my 8-year-old dog. Her surgery went perfectly, and they were always attentive and kind to me. I would definitely return and recommend this vet, especially if you have a small breed dog.

Be careful about their diagnosis! I took my cat there more than a year ago because of some issues he was having. They tested him and concluded his kidneys were fine. Well, last week he really went down hill. I took him to a different vet who said he had very bad kidney problems (stage 4) that have been getting worse for a while. I showed the new vet and a kidney specialist the results from my earlier visit to this vet, and I was told that he had kidney problems at that time that could have been treated and he could have lived much longer. But it was too late, and he died.
Excellent care, unfortunately my dog's puppies showed no signs of life and sadly died, but luckily they were able to operate on her and she survived.
They politely told me they couldn't help me and that I should come back during the week in the morning.
Excellent service, highly recommended
Very kind and attentive, thank you
Excellent care for your pet!
My dogs have been attending for years, always very nice treatment, very well-trained staff
Very good service
Very efficient place

An excellent hospital! I highly recommend it. ✨️💯

Dr. Juan Carlos Almaráz is an incredible doctor, surgeon, and human being. 😊

My dog, Maia, needed a somewhat complicated and advanced surgery (a splenectomy). She had lesions on her spleen that could have been malignant, and the best way to avoid future complications was to remove it. Two hours after her surgery, Maia was walking around as if nothing had happened. 😍

I will be eternally grateful for all their attention, care, and support! Thank you so much. 🥰
The lady was very kind and professional, but the prices were very expensive.
24-hour emergency service. They are humane and take good care of pets.
I took my kitten in for severe poisoning, they pulled her through and I'm so grateful ❤️‍🩹🐈 …

I really liked it; it's the first time I've taken my dog ​​for a general checkup and deworming.

The place is clean, the service was excellent, and the prices seemed fair. We also liked that it's open 24/7, so we can take her there more easily.

I now consider it my first choice for veterinarians.

Edit 2026_________ I'm changing it to 2 stars because this last visit, just for annual vaccinations and deworming, was extremely expensive!! 🥲 Almost 2000 pesos, and on top of that, they asked us to run tests "before" deworming her. The previous times it wasn't so expensive; this time it felt like they were trying to rip us off. I don't know what happened.
Excellent service, very attentive. You can get all kinds of tests done on your dog here. I highly recommend it.

I took my kitten to the vet one night because she couldn't walk and we didn't know if she'd been bitten. We went and they took an x-ray, and they even wanted to operate on her the next day. In short order, it cost us over $2,000. They didn't do anything for her; the person wasn't even a cat specialist and couldn't even interpret the x-ray. Terrible service.
Until today I highly recommended them, but today one of their trainees hurt my kitten and they didn't give me any help... Sadly, there are still "professionals" who harm pets.
The staff are extremely kind and friendly, they gave us a lot of emotional support and dedicated care to our little pet 🩷 …

As always, everything was great with the veterinarians, but they changed the receptionist. A blonde woman with earrings, her manner and the way she addresses you is the rudest, most awful person. She acts like she owns the place and thinks she's always right.
Super friendly, excellent service, truly highly recommended
Excellent service and great professionalism, highly recommended.

They are very kind and honest.

I didn't know where to take my pit bull; he was lethargic, vomiting, and wouldn't eat. I took him to this center, and he did very well. They gave him medication, and the follow-up care is excellent. The tests are reasonably priced, and I understand that tests need to be done before making assumptions or starting treatment. My experience was very positive.
Good place to bring dogs and cats for medical check-ups 🩻, therapies, surgeries, boarding, and deworming. …
They're outrageously expensive; the medication is ridiculously overpriced. They took x-rays of my kitten but didn't give them back to me. I don't recommend them.

Excellent service! You can tell they truly love animals and care about their patients.
Fair and transparent prices. Excellent value for money.
My dogs Zora and Tsuki are patients of Doctors Elizabeth and Natalia. They are wonderful doctors. And all the staff are very friendly. 🫶🏼
Whenever I take them, I feel they are in good and reliable hands. 🤍
Excellent hospital, very good care from all the staff

‼️‼️ Yesterday we went to the vet because my dog ​​was urinating blood. They examined her and said they would do a so-called ultrasound scan of her bladder. Initially, they took her away and wouldn't let us accompany her. They returned with a picture of an ultrasound on the vet's phone and told us, very alarmistly, that she had a lump, which could be a tumor in her bladder. They said we had to return tomorrow to see the specialist and determine if she needed surgery. They prescribed medication and charged an exorbitant price. Today, Monday, we went for a second and third opinion with her trusted vet. They performed an ultrasound (during which they did allow us to be with her) and explained the diagnosis step by step. There is no tumor; she only has a urinary tract infection that is being treated with antibiotics and special food (TWO OTHER DOCTORS CONFIRMED THIS TODAY). Yesterday they showed us an ultrasound that was NOT hers. They didn't shave her, so they didn't perform an ultrasound and prescribed medication that would NOT help her. They were only looking for a surgery she didn't need and to make money off unnecessary tests. It's so sad that they profit from the health of animals, filling us humans with panic, and on top of that, they charge exorbitant prices. WE DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS PLACE. The doctor who treated her is named Mayra Daniela Contreras Vázquez.

I don't recommend this place. The doctor is very kind, but unfortunately, she's inexperienced. Today, I went in for an emergency in the middle of the night because my dog ​​was coughing and having trouble breathing, and I ended up at another vet because she couldn't solve the problem. The doctor told me it was a tracheal obstruction, which she didn't even know how to fix, and sent me to other vets, which she wrote down on the prescription. My dog ​​actually had pneumonia. This is the first time I've gone there because it's nearby, and it will be the last. The consultation fee is also expensive considering she doesn't know how to diagnose my dog.
Excellent service, they treated my dog ​​like royalty, 100% recommended. The orthopedist is very attentive and the reception staff are super friendly.

I brought my dog ​​in after he was hit by a car, and they immediately received him and gave him the care he needed. He was hospitalized; visiting hours are from 10 a.m. to 12 p.m. and from 5 p.m. to 7 p.m. There are many veterinarians who provide services depending on the hours.

The worst experience ever was taking my dog ​​there. Seriously, look for other options. They charge exorbitant prices and you don't even solve your dog's health problem. The consultation and two medications they administered cost me $3,900 🤷🏻😡🤬 and there was absolutely no improvement in my pet. …
Excellent care from MVZ Enya Peña who treats cats
Excellent service and really friendly veterinarians

Terrible, they have no hygiene. I took my cat to the vet and they infested him with fleas. I've had my cat for over 7 years and he's never had fleas before, and he's neutered and doesn't go outside. Plus, they charged me an exorbitant price.
Excellent service and accurate diagnoses, thank you for your care of Dumbo 🤗 …

Excellent service, kind and caring with the animals.

We especially recommend Dr. Elizabeth.

I received an incorrect diagnosis. They performed blood tests, and only after I was home did they call to inform me that one of the results was incorrect because they used an expired test, so they still don't know what's wrong with me. This was after I had already purchased the entire treatment from their clinic for the erroneous diagnosis they gave me.
Terrible service, they are arrogant and charge you for everything, even breathing.
My dog ​​had emergency surgery and she came out great! Excellent hospital and vet.
Excellent service, well-trained doctors, and fair prices.
Great attention
The service is top-notch, the care is excellent and professional, the doctors treat you in a comfortable environment, and it specializes in felines. Highly recommended.
Good service and attention to my puppies

My cat would still be alive if not for this vet clinic. When he was a kitten, we brought him in because he was drinking excessively. They did various blood tests, and one was for his kidneys. The vet told me his levels were slightly elevated, but that was normal for a kitten of his age. Well, about two months ago, he became very sick and the emergency vet we went to figured out that he had stage 4 kidney disease. He wasn't even 2 years old. We then took him to a kidney specialist who tried to stabilize him. I showed them the blood tests that Centro Vet did when he was a kitten, and showed the message they sent me saying the tests were normal. The nephrologist said that the results of his blood tests were in fact, not normal, and that he should have been treated for kidney disease back then. Unfortunately his disease had progressed too far and we had to put him to sleep. I am absolutely devasted about losing him, and it's just made worse knowing that he would still be here with us if Centro Vet hadn't given us bad information. Please, take your cats anywhere else.

Excellent service from all the staff, clean place, and above all, the treatment of the animals is wonderful. They care for them with great affection and respect. The veterinary care is very good. Very professional.

It's an excellent veterinary center with a caring approach and timely, professional follow-up. If they can't help you, they're always willing to offer alternatives and, above all, help you find the right specialist for your pet. The treatment is gentle, kind, and very dedicated. Highly recommended. Only the attitude of the staff at the register sometimes leaves something to be desired; however, that doesn't detract from the overall quality of care.
They treat pets well and I'll open for hours

Yes, I highly recommend this clinic. They helped my dog ​​after she had surgery at another place and her intestine perforated. At this hospital, they saved her, operated on her again, and pulled her through. I am very grateful to Dr. Juan Carlos, who did an excellent job, and to the entire hospital team who treated my dog ​​Gala so well, from the reception staff who were always so attentive and kind. Thank you!
The prices were outrageously high, and in the end they didn't even cure her and we had to go somewhere else for treatment.

The best!! I have a very delicate pitbull with several medical issues, and they always diagnose him right away. He's had several surgeries, and the care is top-notch. Dr. Rubén is the best ✨
Highly professional, 100% recommended

Excellent service, I was delighted. They saved my baby Whisky, whose intestine was perforated by a toy 😞 They are always very kind and humane with their four-legged patients 🐾 …

I find it very strange that you have such good reviews overall, because when I took my two dogs there for vaccinations and a bath, they neither bathed nor vaccinated them, and they injured my dog, leaving a cut on her face over 10 cm long. No one took responsibility; the manager told me their only mistake was accepting my dog. Then, when I posted on social media, I received comments about many bad practices at that veterinary clinic. There's no better veterinary clinic to care for your pets. They're attentive, friendly, and provide thorough consultations. They're also very empathetic in difficult situations. Don't hesitate to bring your pets here.

The best veterinary hospital ever! The doctors are incredibly kind and skilled; you can tell they love their profession and their patients. The staff is fantastic, the facilities are superb, and they're open 24 hours. It's not cheap, but it's totally worth it. They saved my two-month-old puppy, who was very weak from parvovirus, parasites, and an ear infection. They took excellent care of him and showered him with affection during his hospital stay. 10/10, highly recommended.

Last night we took my puppy, she's a Shih Tzu. We were so worried she'd leave. The birth was so complicated, they welcomed her with so much love, and today my son went to see her and says she's very calm ❤️
God willing, everything will be alright ☺️

I took my dog ​​to this vet and they took half an hour to see her, even though I was alone in the office. When they finally saw her, they took x-rays that were completely unrelated to her condition. They also sold me medicine I didn't need.

If you can go with someone else, it would be much better. I went to another vet the next day and the service was completely different.

I will never go back and I recommend you don't.
Terrible service and extremely expensive, they mistreat the animals and refuse to take responsibility. A dreadful place.

My dog ​​was mistreated; she had a wound on her face, and no one at the vet clinic took responsibility or explained how she was injured. She wasn't vaccinated or bathed. She needed 20 stitches for the facial wound, and they charged me 1200 pesos.
